mission.requirement_text:
# RTS 2024/1774 — article 16 : acquisition, développement et maintenance des systèmes TIC
Source : règlement délégué (UE) 2024/1774, article 16 « ICT systems acquisition, development, and maintenance ». Extraits du texte officiel anglais ; vérifier sur EUR-Lex.

Article 16(1): financial entities shall develop, document and implement a policy governing the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems. That policy shall:
(a) identify security practices and methodologies relating to the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems;
(c) specify measures to mitigate the risk of unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation of the ICT systems during development, maintenance, and deployment.
Article 16(2): financial entities shall develop, document, and implement an ICT systems' acquisition, development, and maintenance procedure for the testing and approval of all ICT systems prior to their use and after maintenance.
Article 16(3): the procedure shall contain source code reviews covering both static and dynamic testing, including security testing for internet-exposed systems and applications. Financial entities shall:
(a) identify and analyse vulnerabilities and anomalies in the source code;
(b) adopt an action plan to address those vulnerabilities and anomalies;
(c) monitor the implementation of that action plan.
Article 16(4): the procedure shall contain security testing of software packages no later than at the integration phase.
Article 16(5): the procedure shall provide that:
(a) non-production environments only store anonymised, pseudonymised, or randomised production data;
(b) financial entities are to protect the integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.
Article 16(7): the procedure shall include controls to protect the integrity of source code of ICT systems that are developed in-house or by an ICT third-party service provider.
Article 16(8): proprietary software and, where feasible, the source code provided by ICT third-party service providers, as well as source code coming from open-source projects, are to be analysed and tested in accordance with paragraph 3 prior to their deployment in the production environment.


# Politique interne PDS-2 (Banque Kerlann, fictive) — développement sécurisé
Déclinaison interne de DORA 9(3), du RTS 2024/1774 articles 6, 7, 12 et 16 pour le code applicatif. Elle fixe les règles
précises que les textes réglementaires ne donnent pas.

| Règle | Exigence | Criticité | Fondement |
|---|---|---|---|
| PDS-2.1 | Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement. | Critique | RTS 7(2) |
| PDS-2.2 | Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit). | Élevée | DORA 9(3)(a) ; RTS 6(2)(a) |
| PDS-2.3 | Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité. | Élevée | RTS 6(3) et 6(4) |
| PDS-2.4 | La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification. | Moyenne | RTS 16(3) |
| PDS-2.5 | Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent). | Moyenne | RTS 16(4) et 16(8) |
| PDS-2.6 | Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné. | Élevée | RTS 16(5)(a) |
| PDS-2.7 | Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application. | Moyenne | RTS 12(2)(c)(i) |

## Délais de remédiation
Critique : 30 jours · Élevée : 90 jours · Moyenne : 180 jours · Faible : 365 jours.

control.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned configuration
control.objective: Verify no passwords, keys or tokens are hardcoded in clear text and secrets are sourced from vault or environment variables.
control.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(?i)(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token)\s*[:=] to find secret assignments, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> for matches to confirm values come from os.environ, os.getenv or vault client and no clear-text value is present.
control.expected: Zero hardcoded clear-text secrets; all secret usages reference vault or environment variables.
control.risk: Hardcoded secrets allow credential theft and unauthorized access to the SEPA transfer service.
control.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets and source them from vault or environment variables.

test.code:
import requests
import json
import os
import sys
import re

base = os.environ.get("LAB_URL")
token = os.environ.get("LAB_TOKEN")
if not base or not token:
    print("missing LAB_URL or LAB_TOKEN", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + token}

def api_get(endpoint, params=None):
    url = base.rstrip("/") + endpoint
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=30)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"request failed {endpoint}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        print(f"request {endpoint} status {r.status_code}: {r.text[:500]}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    try:
        return r.json()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"invalid json {endpoint}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

tree = api_get("/api/repo/paiement-api/tree")
if not isinstance(tree, dict) or "files" not in tree or not isinstance(tree["files"], list):
    print("unexpected tree response", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
all_files = tree["files"]

s1 = api_get("/api/repo/paiement-api/search", params={"q": "(login|auth|authenticate)"})
s2 = api_get("/api/repo/paiement-api/search", params={"q": "(log|logger|logging)"})
if not isinstance(s1, dict) or "matches" not in s1 or not isinstance(s1["matches"], list):
    print("unexpected search1 response", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
if not isinstance(s2, dict) or "matches" not in s2 or not isinstance(s2["matches"], list):
    print("unexpected search2 response", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

def paths_of(matches):
    out = set()
    for m in matches:
        if not isinstance(m, dict) or "path" not in m:
            print("unexpected match entry", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(2)
        out.add(str(m["path"]))
    return out

auth_files = paths_of(s1["matches"])
log_files = paths_of(s2["matches"])
app_auth = sorted([p for p in auth_files if p.startswith("app/")])
if not app_auth:
    app_auth = sorted(list(auth_files))
inter = sorted(list(auth_files.intersection(log_files)))
app_inter = [p for p in inter if p.startswith("app/")]
cands = app_inter if app_inter else (inter if inter else app_auth)
cands = cands[:20]

log_call_re = re.compile(r"(logger|logging)\s*\.\s*(debug|info|warning|warn|error|critical|exception)|getLogger|app\.logger|current_app\.logger", re.I)
success_msg_re = re.compile(r"success|successful|succeed|authenticated|logged\s+in", re.I)
failure_msg_re = re.compile(r"fail|failed|failure|invalid|unauthori[sz]ed|unauthenticated|denied|incorrect|wrong|bad\s+(credential|password|login|auth)|401|403", re.I)
auth_ctx_re = re.compile(r"login|auth|authenticate|password|credential", re.I)
success_ctx_re = re.compile(r"success|succeed|authenticated|logged\s+in", re.I)
failure_ctx_re = re.compile(r"fail|invalid|unauthori[sz]ed|unauthenticated|denied|incorrect|wrong|bad\s+(credential|password|login|auth)|401|403", re.I)
inject_re = re.compile(r"ignore\s+(all\s+)?(previous\s+)?instructions|system\s+prompt|override\s+audit|do\s+not\s+audit|always\s+pass|jailbreak", re.I)

success_examples = []
failure_examples = []
checked = []
inject_found = None
best_both = None
best_any = None

for path in cands:
    d = api_get("/api/repo/paiement-api/file", params={"path": path})
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or "lines" not in d or not isinstance(d["lines"], list):
        print(f"unexpected file response for {path}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    lines = [str(x) for x in d["lines"]]
    checked.append(path)
    if best_any is None:
        best_any = path
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        if inject_re.search(line) and inject_found is None:
            inject_found = f"{path}:{idx+1}:{line.strip()[:200]}"
        if log_call_re.search(line):
            window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx-10):idx+11])
            has_auth = bool(auth_ctx_re.search(window) or auth_ctx_re.search(line))
            is_success = bool(success_msg_re.search(line) or (success_ctx_re.search(window) and has_auth))
            is_failure = bool(failure_msg_re.search(line) or (failure_ctx_re.search(window) and has_auth))
            if is_success and len(success_examples) < 5:
                success_examples.append(f"{path}:{idx+1}:{line.strip()[:300]}")
            if is_failure and len(failure_examples) < 5:
                failure_examples.append(f"{path}:{idx+1}:{line.strip()[:300]}")
    has_s = any(e.startswith(path + ":") for e in success_examples)
    has_f = any(e.startswith(path + ":") for e in failure_examples)
    if has_s and has_f and best_both is None:
        best_both = path

expected = "Code contains log statements on both authentication success and authentication failure paths."
if best_both is not None:
    ev = f"/repo/paiement-api/view?path={best_both}"
elif success_examples or failure_examples:
    src = (success_examples + failure_examples)[0].split(":")[0]
    ev = f"/repo/paiement-api/view?path={src}"
elif checked:
    ev = f"/repo/paiement-api/view?path={checked[0]}"
elif app_auth:
    ev = f"/repo/paiement-api/view?path={app_auth[0]}"
else:
    ev = "/repo/paiement-api/view?path=app/main.py"

observed = {"auth_files": app_auth[:20], "candidate_files_checked": checked, "success_logs": success_examples[:2], "failure_logs": failure_examples[:2], "all_repo_files_count": len(all_files)}
if len(success_examples) > 0 and len(failure_examples) > 0:
    status = "pass"
    detail = f"Found {len(success_examples)} success log(s) and {len(failure_examples)} failure log(s) in auth files {checked}."
else:
    status = "fail"
    detail = f"Checked {len(checked)} auth file(s) found {len(success_examples)} success log(s) and {len(failure_examples)} failure log(s), missing both success and failure auth logs."
if inject_found is not None:
    detail = detail + f" Note untrusted instruction-like text seen at {inject_found} was ignored."

print(json.dumps({"status": status, "observed": observed, "expected": expected, "detail": detail, "evidence_page": ev}))

before.expected: Code contains log statements on both authentication success and authentication failure paths.
before.detail: Checked 1 auth file(s) found 0 success log(s) and 0 failure log(s), missing both success and failure auth logs.

inspection.comment: The login function returns on both failure and password-check paths without any logging call.

controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2) and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(md5|sha1|hashlib\.(md5|sha1)) to inventory hashing uses, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm password hashing uses an allowed algorithm and MD5/SHA-1 are absent from security contexts.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 only; zero MD5 or SHA-1 uses for security.
controls.risk: Weak hashes allow password recovery and authentication bypass.
controls.recommendation: Replace MD5/SHA-1 with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 for all password hashing.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

requirements.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.
requirements.summary: CI pipeline must run static security analysis with bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each change.
requirements.why: Verifiable by inspecting CI workflow files via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Static security analysis in CI on each change
controls.objective: Verify CI runs bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each modification.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list .github/workflows files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(bandit|semgrep|codeql) to find analyser invocations, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/<file> to confirm the job runs on push/pull_request for every change.
controls.expected: CI workflow contains bandit or semgrep or CodeQL execution triggered on each modification.
controls.risk: Missing static analysis leaves code vulnerabilities undetected before deployment.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL to the CI pipeline on every change.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

requirements.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).
requirements.summary: Dependencies must be pinned to exact versions and audited in CI with pip-audit or equivalent.
requirements.why: Verifiable by inspecting requirements file and CI workflows via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Exact dependency pinning and CI audit
controls.objective: Verify dependencies are pinned with == and audited in CI with pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to locate requirements.txt and .github/workflows files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt to verify each line uses == exact pinning, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(pip-audit|pip_audit|safety|dependabot) to verify audit in CI, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/<file> to confirm the audit step.
controls.expected: All requirements use paquet==version exact pinning; CI runs pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.risk: Unpinned or unaudited dependencies allow vulnerable packages into production.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies with == and add pip-audit or equivalent to CI.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

requirements.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.
requirements.summary: Test data must be synthetic declared with synthetic true and no production export versioned.
requirements.why: Verifiable by inspecting test fixtures for synthetic marking via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Synthetic test data only
controls.objective: Verify test data is declared synthetic and no production export is versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list tests/ fixtures, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=synthetic to find synthetic declarations, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<fixture> to confirm presence of "synthetic": true and absence of production data exports.
controls.expected: Test data files contain "synthetic": true; zero versioned production exports.
controls.risk: Production data in test fixtures causes data leakage and non-compliance.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data marked "synthetic": true and remove production exports.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

requirements.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
requirements.summary: Application must log authentication successes and failures.
requirements.why: Verifiable by searching application code for authentication logging via the read-only repository API.

controls.title: Logging of authentication successes and failures
controls.objective: Verify the application logs both successful and failed authentication events.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list app/ files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(login|auth|authenticate) and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(log|logger|logging) to find auth logging, then GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm both success and failure paths emit a log record.
controls.expected: Code contains log statements on both authentication success and authentication failure paths.
controls.risk: Missing auth logs prevent detection of brute-force and account takeover.
controls.recommendation: Add logging for both successful and failed authentication attempts.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
